title: "برائے دلِ دختر"
language: "Urdu"

romanLyrics: |-
  Haye Hussaina, vaye Hussaina,
  Ay vaye Sakina, aie vaaye Sakina.

  1
  Yeh rukhsat e aakhir hai pukaray shah e wala,
  Aie Zainab o Kulsum Rabab aur Ruqaya,
  Tum sab pay salaam akhri Allah ko sonpa,
  Lipti huyi qadmoon say yeh kehti thi Sakina.

  2
  Aie kul ke madadgar madad karne ko aao,
  Ya Fatima Zahra mere baba ko bachao.

  3
  Baba na kaho baba, tum saath raho baba,
  Kuch hum say suno baba, aagay na barho baba,
  Aaram karo baba, baray e dil e dukhtar,
  (baraye dil e dukhtar – for the sake of your daughter)
  (baraye dil e dukhtar – baiti kay dil kay liye)
  Baraye dil e in dukhtar, khaimoon mein chalo baba.

  4
  Aie kul ke madadgar madad karne ko aao,
  Ya Fatima Zahra mere baba ko bachao.

  5
  Juyam bay kuja baba, dar dasht to ra baba?
  (Where should I look father, where in the desert are you?)
  (Kahan dhundu baba, tumhein is dasht mein baba?)
  Nazdam to biya baba, yaad az in wafa baba,
  (Come close father, give me your love and affection)
  (Nazdeek aa jao baba, izada wafa mujhe day do)
  Lutfan benuma baba, baraay e dile dukhtar,
  (For the sake of loyalty, for the sake of your daughter)
  (Apna lutf o karam, baiti ke dil ke liye)
  Baraaye dil e dukhtar, ay baba ma ro baba.
  (For the sake of this daughter, come back father)
  (Is baiti ke dil ke liye, wapas aa jao father)

  6
  Aie kul ke madadgar madad karne ko aao,
  Ya Fatima Zahra mere baba ko bachao.

  7
  Mein jan gayi baba, pehchan gayi baba,
  Qurbaan gayi baba, talwaroon mein jao gay,
  Phir tum bhi na aao gay, baraye dil e dukhtar,
  (baraye dil e dukhtar – for the sake of your daughter)
  (baraye dil e dukhtar – baiti kay dil kay liye)
  Baraye dil e dukhtar, tum hum ko na tarpana.

  8
  Aie kul ke madadgar madad karne ko aao,
  Ya Fatima Zahra mere baba ko bachao.

  9
  Aaya dukhtar e nistam? yekhta gohar e nistam?
  (Am I not your daughter? Am I not a priceless gem?)
  (Kiya mein aapki beti nahin houn? kiya yakta gohar nahin hoon?
  Noor e nazarat e nistam? ya hamsafar e nistam,
  (Am I not the light of your eyes? or, am I not a fellow traveller?
  (Noor e nazar nahin hoon? ya humsafar nahin houn?)
  Gar bargardi man nistam, baray e dil e dukhtar,
  (If you go you shall not find me when you return, for the sake of your daughter)
  (Agar gaye to wapas mein mujhe nahin pao gay, beti kay dil kay liye)
  Baraay e dil e dukhtar, bargard o biya baba.
  (For the sake of this daughter, come back father)
  (Iss baiti ke dil ke liye, wapas aa jao baba)

  10
  Aie kul ke madadgar madad karne ko aao,
  Ya Fatima Zahra mere baba ko bachao.

  11
  Baba aie mere baba, lazim hai agar jana,
  Yeh hum say karo wada, jab shab ka ho san’nata,
  Aur meri sada suna, baraye dil e dukhtar,
  (baraye dil e dukhtar – for the sake of your daughter)
  (baraye dil e dukhtar – baiti kay dil kay liye)
  Baraaye dile dukhtar, tum lot kay aa jana.

  12
  Aie kul ke madadgar madad karne ko aao,
  Ya Fatima Zahra mere baba ko bachao.

  13
  Babaye mani baba, lazim shud e gar raftan,
  (O my father, O father if it is necessary to go)
  (Baba aie mere baba, lazim hai agar jana)
  In waadey e ma bashad, dar tarikiy e shab ha,
  (Make a promise to me, when darkness spreads of night)
  (Aik wada mujh say karo, jab raat ki tariki cha jaye)
  Bishnu chun sada e man, baraay e dil e dukhtar,
  (And you listen to my cry, for the sake of your daughter)
  (Aur meri sada suno, baiti kay dil kay liye)
  Baraay e dil e in dukhtar, baaz aayi baraay e maan
  (For the sake of this daughter, come back father)
  (Is baiti kay dil kay liye, wapas aa jao baba)

  14
  Aie kul ke madadgar madad karne ko aao,
  Ya Fatima Zahra mere baba ko bachao.

  15
  Sheh bolay Sakina jaan, sou jaan say main qurban,
  Is tarha na ho giryan, eik wada nibhana hai,
  Eik qarz purana hai, baraye dil e dukhtar,
  Baraay e dil e baba, tum aaj dua karna.

  16
  Aie kul ke madadgar madad karne ko aao,
  Ya Fatima Zahra mere baba ko bachao.

  17
  Pursa hai paye e maula, Rehan o Ali Jee ka,
  Kartay the haram noha, Sarwar nay kaha baiti,
  Sa’at hai judayi ki, baraay e dil e dukhtar,
  Baraay e dil e baba, maqtal na chali aana.

from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/data/lyrics/braie-dil-dukhtar.md')
original = path.read_text()
before, rest = original.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
_, source = rest.split('\\n---\\n', 1)
refrain = \"\"\"Ae kul ke madadgaar, madad karne ko aao
Ya Fatima Zahra mere baba ko bachao\"\"\"
stanzas = [
\"\"\"Haaye Husaina, vaaye Husaina
Ae vaaye Sakina, ae vaaye Sakina
Yeh rukhsat-e-aakhir hai, pukaare shah-e-waala
Ae Zainab o Kulsum, Rabab aur Ruqayya
Tum sab pe salaam aakhri, Allah ko sonpa
Lipti hui qadmoṅ se yeh kehti thi Sakina\"\"\",
refrain,
\"\"\"Baba na kaho baba
Tum saath raho baba
Kuchh ham se suno baba
Aage na barho baba
Aaraam karo baba
Baraaye dil-e-dukhtar
Khaime mein chalo baba\"\"\",
refrain,
\"\"\"Main jaan gai baba
Pehchaan gai baba
Qurbaan gai baba
Talwaaroṅ mein jaoge
Phir tum bhi na aaoge
Baraaye dil-e-dukhtar
Tum ham ko na tarpaana\"\"\",
refrain,
\"\"\"Baba yeh mere baba
Laazim hai agar jaana
Yeh ham se karo waada
Jab shab ka ho sannaata
Aur meri sada sunna
Baraaye dil-e-dukhtar
Tum laut ke aa jaana\"\"\",
refrain,
\"\"\"Shah bole Sakina jab
Sau jaan se main qurbaaṅ
Is tarah na ho giryaaṅ
Ik waada nibhaana hai
Ik qarz puraana hai
Baraaye dil-e-dukhtar
Baraaye dil-e-baba
Tum aaj dua karna\"\"\",
refrain,
\"\"\"Pursa hai pay-e-Maula
Rehan o Ali Ji ka
Karte the haram noha
Sarwar ne kaha beti
Saat hai judaai ki
Baraaye dil-e-dukhtar
Baraaye dil-e-baba
Maqtal na chali aana\"\"\",
refrain,
]
source_stanzas = source.strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert len(stanzas) == len(source_stanzas) == 12
for number, (roman, urdu) in enumerate(zip(stanzas, source_stanzas), 1):
    heading, *verses = urdu.splitlines()
    assert heading == str(number).translate(str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'))
    assert len(roman.splitlines()) == len(verses), number
assert sum(len(stanza.splitlines()) for stanza in stanzas) == 55
roman = '\\n\\n'.join(
    '\\n'.join([f'  {number}', *(f'  {line}' for line in stanza.splitlines())])
    for number, stanza in enumerate(stanzas, 1)
)
updated = before + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman + '\\n---\\n' + source
path.write_text(updated)
assert path.read_text().split('\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == source
PY"

item.text: Audited [braie-dil-dukhtar.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/176779abe6a94126a39eb56f5cf092b6/src/data/lyrics/braie-dil-dukhtar.md). The Roman transliteration now follows all 55 Urdu verse lines across 12 stanzas. I corrected phonetic spellings and removed parenthetical translations and three Persian passages absent from the Urdu body. The source text and other metadata are unchanged.
